page.layout: Two parallel columns of Hebrew verb forms with Latin glosses, left column then right column. Below the right column, one Hebrew word at the right margin. Running head at the top, page number at top left.

main_text.p: et depsit, pro וַיַּחֲלִישׁ, fut. Kal, 3. s. fæm. conv. Rad. חָלַשׁ [?]
וַיִּתְּמֹם et liquefecisti, apoc. pro וַיִּמְסֹם, fut. Hiphil 2. s. m. conv. R. מָסַס
וַיִּמְרֶה et rebellavit, apoc. pro וַיַּמְרֶה, fut. Hiph. 3. s. fæm. conv. R. מָרָה
וַתָּמָת et mortua fuit, fut. Kal, 3. s. fæm. conv. pro וַתָּמֹת, Rad. מוּת.
וַתָּנַח et quievit, pro וַתָּנַח, fut. Kal, 3. s. fæm. conv. Rad. נוּחַ.
וַתָּנָס et fugit, pro וַתָּנֹס, fut. Kal, 3. s. fæm. conv. Rad. נוּס.
וַיָּסֵר et amovit, pro וַיָּסֵר, fut. Hiph. 3. s. fæm. conv. Rad. סוּר.
וַיָּעַד et contestatus fuisti, pro וַיָּעֵד, fut. Hiph. 2. s. m. conv. Rad. עוּד.
וַתַּעַשׂ et illa ornavit se, pro וַתַּעֲשֶׂה, fut. Kal, 3. s. fæm. conv. Rad. עָשָׂה.
וַתַּעַשׂ et robora-ta fuit, pro וַתָּשׁ, fut. Kal, 3. s. fæm. conv. Rad. עָשׂ.

וַתַּעֲמֹס et amicivit, et contendit, forma, quasi apoc. pro וַתַּעֲמֹס, fut. Kal, 3. sing. fæm. conv. à Rad. עָטָה obvolvit; sed est, pro וַתָּעֹט, vel וַתָּעֵט, fut. Hiph. 3. sing. fæm. conv. à Rad. עוּט, vel עֵיט involare.
וַתַּעַל et ascendit, vel ascendere fecit, apoc. pro וַתַּעֲלֶה, fut. Kal, vel Hiph. 3. s. fæm. vel 2. s. m. Rad. עָלָה.
וַתַּעַן & respondit, apoc. pro וַתַּעֲנֶה, fut. Kal, 3. s. fæm. conv. Rad. עָנָה.
וַתַּעַשׂ et fecit, s. vel fecisti, v. apoc. pro וַתַּעֲשֶׂה, fut. Kal, 3. sing. fæm. vel 2. s. m. conv. Rad. עָשָׂה.
וַתִּפְנֶה et vertit se, apoc. pro וַתִּפְנֶה, fut. Kal, 3. s. fæm. conv. Rad. פָּנָה.

page.notes: Hebrew vocalisation and several Hebrew forms are uncertain at this scan resolution and are marked [?] where doubtful. The running head and page number are read from a low-resolution print and should be checked. The line "et robora-ta fuit" and the Hebrew "וַתַּעַשׂ" in the right column are close in form and may be misreadings.
